what: per fold-6 structure, the references of each competitor transfer library that are the structure's own protein, and the exclusion list that blocks them
rule: a library reference is the same protein as a fold-6 structure if it is the structure's BMRB entry, shares a UniProt accession or UniRef100 cluster with it, or aligns to its entity or chain sequence at >=95% identity over >=90% of the shorter sequence
